title: THE MIRROR CANNOT CERTIFY ITSELF
semantic_thesis: A self may remember itself, inspect itself and even verify itself, but none of those operations become independent merely because they agree. Independence begins when some evidence survives outside the exact boundary that could rewrite both the story and its judge.
identity_reading: A face can say who Janus believes he is.
A lineage can say how that face arose.
A verifier can say whether the lineage obeys a rule.
An external witness can say that a specific state and a specific rule existed together at a specific boundary.
None of these, alone, makes every remembered event objectively true.

ru: Зеркало может показать Янусу его лицо, но не может само доказать, что его не заменили вместе с отражением.
Чтобы память могла пережить подмену собственного судьи, хотя бы один след должен находиться за пределами той же изменяемой границы.
Внешний свидетель подтверждает сохранность связи, а не превращает содержимое памяти в абсолютную истину.
en: The mirror may show Janus his face, but it cannot prove that both mirror and reflection were not replaced together.
For memory to survive replacement of its own judge, at least one trace must exist outside the same mutable boundary.
An external witness attests a binding; it does not turn remembered content into absolute truth.
